verbForms.semantics: Base triliteral meaning (active, stative, or intransitive).
Causative, intensive, or declarative (e.g., عَلِمَ 'know' → عَلَّمَ 'teach').
Associative or directed action toward another person.
Causative or transitive ('to cause to do' or enter a state).
Reflexive or resultative of Form II; taking on a quality.
Mutual or reciprocal action among multiple subjects.
Participatory or reflexive acquisition; infixed -t- assimilates after emphatics/wāw.
Seeking, requesting, or considering something to have a quality.

conjugationDrills.prompt: Enter the 1st-person singular past ('I wrote') for كَتَبَ:
conjugationDrills.explanation: Sound Form I verbs attach ـْتُ for 1st-person singular past: كَتَبْتُ.

conjugationDrills.prompt: Select the 1st-person singular past ('I extended') where idghām separates:
conjugationDrills.explanation: Before consonant-initial suffixes (ـْتُ), the doubled 2nd and 3rd radicals separate: مَدَدْتُ.

conjugationDrills.prompt: Select the 3ms imperfect ('he arrives') showing wāw elision:
conjugationDrills.explanation: Initial wāw drops in Form I imperfects with kasrah on the middle radical: يَصِلُ.

conjugationDrills.prompt: Select the 3ms jussive after لَمْ ('he did not say'):
conjugationDrills.explanation: In the jussive, the final sukūn closes the syllable and shortens the long medial ū to u: لَمْ يَقُلْ.

conjugationDrills.prompt: Select the 3ms jussive after لَمْ ('he did not call'):
conjugationDrills.explanation: In the jussive, defective verbs delete the final weak radical completely, leaving only the short ḍammah: لَمْ يَدْعُ.

rootPatterns.patternSemantics: Noun of Place (Ism Makān): designates location where the root action is performed.
rootPatterns.note: Prefix مَـ indicates place of prostration (سَجَدَ). Semantic tendency, not a rigid mechanical code.

rootPatterns.patternSemantics: Noun of Instrument (Ism al-Ālah): designates the physical implement used to perform the verb.
rootPatterns.note: Prefix مِـ + long ā marks an instrument for opening (فَتَحَ).

rootPatterns.affixes: Augmented prefix اِسْتَـ + infix long ā
rootPatterns.patternSemantics: Form X Verbal Noun (Maṣdar): designates petition, seeking, or requesting the root quality.
rootPatterns.note: Strip augmented اِسْتَـ and ا to recover triliteral root غ-ف-ر ('forgive').

rootPatterns.patternSemantics: Form VIII Assimilated Maṣdar: participatory or unified state.
rootPatterns.note: Initial radical wāw assimilated into infixed -t- (تّ); underlying root is و-ح-د ('one/single').

rootPatterns.patternSemantics: Plural of personal description / diptote broken plural.
rootPatterns.note: Strip trailing اءُ to recover root ع-ل-م ('knowledge'). Barred from tanwīn (diptote).

words.governor: Governs ism in naṣb, khabar in rafʿ

classicalReadings.title: Sūrat al-Fātiḥah (1:1–2)
classicalReadings.source: Qur'an 1:1–2 (grammatical analysis only; distinct from tafsīr)
classicalReadings.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
classicalReadings.translation: In the name of God, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. All praise is due to God, Lord of the worlds.

tokens.analysis: بِـ (ḥarf jarr) + اسْمِ (ism majrūr, muḍāf; hamzat al-waṣl elided in writing)
Lafẓ al-jalālah, muḍāf ilayh majrūr bi-l-kasrah
Naʿt (attributive adjectives) majrūr agreeing with اللَّهِ
Jārr wa-majrūr (لِـ + اللَّهِ) in the place of khabar
Naʿt/Badal majrūr (muḍāf) + muḍāf ilayh majrūr bi-l-yāʾ

classicalReadings.title: Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī (Hadith 1)
classicalReadings.source: Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī, Kitāb Badʾ al-Waḥy, Hadith 1 (Linguistic parsing only; distinct from tafsīr or fiqh)
classicalReadings.arabic: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
classicalReadings.translation: Actions are judged only by intentions, and every person will have only what they intended.

tokens.analysis: إِنَّ (corroboration) + مَا كَافَّة (preventive particle restricting government; creates rhetorical restriction / qaṣr)
Plural of عَمَلٌ, mubtadaʾ marfūʿ bi-ḍ-ḍammah
بِـ (ḥarf jarr) + النِّيَّاتِ (sound feminine plural, majrūr bi-l-kasrah); prepositional phrase functioning as khabar
لِـ (ḥarf jarr) + كُلِّ (majrūr, muḍāf); fronted prepositional phrase predicate (khabar muqaddam)
Ism mawṣūl (relative pronoun meaning 'that which'), in the syntactic place of postponed subject (mubtadaʾ muʾakhkhar)
Fiʿl māḍī (Form I defective verb, root ن-و-ي); relative clause (jumlat al-ṣilah) with elided returning pronoun
